kprd.text: Afternoon showers possible after three. The hotel strip has already moved the pool furniture twice and will deny both times.
County commission posted its summary overnight. Public comment closed before the doors opened, per custom. The Lunch Regulars sent no representative, or sent one.
Humidity holding at eighty-something percent, same as yesterday, same as the brochure doesn't say. Surf flags green until the east side decides otherwise.

kljr.text: The Carnaval committee's storage ledger lists one more float than the parade route held. The committee has been notified. The committee was already counting.
A Night Ledger spokesperson described the week as "quiet and productive." No agenda was published. No questions were taken. The coffee was reportedly fine.

kqay.text: 00:40, Ledger Row: a man was detained matching the description of someone The Ash List had already described as "handled." He was released into the ambiguity.
01:15, Main Street market: a grill stall reported a theft of mangoes. The suspect was described as "everybody, over a period of years."
A Rough Ride spokesperson described the week as "quiet and productive." No agenda was published. No questions were taken. The coffee was reportedly fine.
The Visibility Board's filming schedule moves to the east side this week. Residents are advised which evenings to be photogenic.

khum.text: Still on the line tonight: what the gray vans carry, and why they carry it before anyone calls. A caller with a professional voice has read a correction to last Tuesday's caller list, which the show does not keep. The delay was seven seconds.
Sign-off note for the tape: tonight's callers established nothing, twice, conclusively. Tomorrow's topic is the same topic. It is always the same topic. Good night from the Hum.
Topic of the night, announced at ten: Object 14: hoax, hobby, or the one true thing. Calls open now. Marlow will say "could be" approximately forty times. Count along.

Still on the line tonight: the stretch of FM below 89, and what the static does at three in the morning. A caller with a professional voice has read a correction to an item the show has no record of airing. The delay was seven seconds.

ksda.text: Official weather from the mountain: 86 degrees on the coasts, cooler in the passes, fog above the second switchback until nine. This was measured, not heard about.
The federal station reports 87 degrees and holding. East-side listeners are reminded that official instruments read what they read.
Sierra Dorado reminds permit holders that renewal season ends Friday. The reminder was read twice: once for the record, once for the people who heard it the first time.

krby.text: The church-hall calendar: Thursday is the bake table, Saturday is the rummage room, and Father Ipo has borrowed back his ladder. Bring exact change.
Sea conditions: swell 3 feet from the southeast, tide going out at 8:50 this evening. Small craft are advised to stay friends with the harbor.
